moments.author: Mark Zuckerberg
moments.quote: Meta has released Muse Code (beta), a terminal coding agent that plans, implements, and validates multi-file changes with persistent sub‑agents
moments.why: This signals Meta entering the AI coding agent race with a tech‑heavy, developer‑focused launch that’s sparking buzz across tech circles.

moments.author: AI at Meta
moments.quote: Introducing Muse Code (beta)... powered by our new Muse Spark 1.2 model. Muse Code plans, implements, and validates complex, multi‑file changes across large repositories with persistent sub‑agents
moments.why: High‑velocity tech community endorsement of Meta’s agentic AI launch is fueling excitement among developers and AI enthusiasts.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Adley Rutschman was reportedly on the way to see 'Spider‑Man: Brand New Day' when he found out he was traded to the Red Sox
moments.why: This vivid, humanizing moment of a star athlete getting traded mid‑outing is viral sports content that’s resonating with fans.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Brock Lesnar has announced his retirement from pro‑wrestling: “I’m just gonna enjoy life... I’m 49 years old and it’s time.”
moments.why: Lesnar’s sudden retirement declaration on X is dominating combat sports chatter.
